profile.summary: The Education Technology Joint Powers Authority (Ed Tech JPA) is a California public agency formed by school districts and a county office of education. It negotiates competitively priced digital technology contracts that California public school agencies can use, and it requires vendors to follow student data privacy rules. Joining as an associate member is currently free.

sources.title: About Us (Irvine Unified School District, Education Technology Joint Powers Authority)

review.notes: The Ed Tech JPA is a California public agency whose members page lists Oakland Unified as an Associate Member, so it is the organization named in the agenda. The summary is neutral and supported: the overview and members pages cover its purpose, privacy requirement and founding members (districts plus El Dorado County), and the 'no cost to join' claim is confirmed on edtechjpa.org/members/becoming-member, which the candidate did not cite.
